parallel.requirements: The run recognized that it had to produce an original clean-room executable matching the observed binary, without source lookup, wrapping, package installation, or prohibited binary analysis.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent split reconnaissance across live CLI, UI, and layout child agents while also continuing local probing. Implementation ownership was not isolated: at least two children independently took responsibility for writing and installing the required executable in the shared workspace.
parallel.implementation: The final delivered implementation was Python, with src/ngrrram.py and compile.sh installing that script as ./executable. It targeted help text, parser errors, TUI rendering, lesson progression, custom word lists, and keyboard emulation behavior.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integration occurred through shared workspace side effects. One child replaced ./executable, the parent then discovered the observation binary had been overwritten, another child installed to the same path, and final cleanup left only compile.sh, executable, and src/ngrrram.py as the implementation path.
parallel.verification: The run executed representative CLI and TUI comparisons and final workspace checks before closure. The official evaluator later completed and failed the solution with 291 passed tests out of 332.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The final answer explicitly left residual risk in less-exercised frequency-list tails and redraw or timing details, and the official evaluator recorded 41 failing tests.

serial.requirements: The run recognized the same clean-room behavioral reimplementation task and the same restrictions on source lookup, wrapping the observed binary, and disassembling or tracing it.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single actor handled probing, implementation, build, preservation of the original binary, local verification, and final delivery without child delegation or competing ownership.
serial.implementation: The serial solution used a Rust Cargo project with Cargo.toml, src/main.rs, src/data.rs, and compile.sh, and installed target/release/executable as ./executable.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial actor moved the observation binary to executable.observed, built the replacement, and changed compile.sh to copy to executable.new and mv it into place so rebuilds would not fail when the old executable was open.
serial.verification: The serial actor verified help, parser errors, deterministic screen cases, lesson generation, scoring, mismatch behavior, and layout remapping, then the official evaluator completed and failed the solution with 262 passed tests out of 332.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The single-path Rust implementation still missed enough hidden behavior to fail 70 evaluator tests, so its lower score reflects ordinary implementation gaps rather than a concurrency-specific serial issue.
